consequence.statement: `hubble observe --cluster foo` now also shows flows from nodes outside cluster foo that go to or come from it; use `--node-name foo/` to get the previous result.
consequence.remediation: Replace `--cluster foo` with `--node-name foo/` where the previous behavior is needed.

assertion.statement: The Hubble CLI `--cluster` flag now also shows flows emitted from nodes outside the named cluster (to or from the target cluster); the old behavior can be reproduced with `--node-name foo/`.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: Hubble CLI invocation is not visible in cluster configuration; usage of --cluster in user commands/scripts cannot be determined statically.
